correctness.rationale: The quotient action is free and order-preserving. Exhaustively generated orbit chain matrices of dimensions 4x24,24x48,48x24 satisfy D^2=0; their exact Smith factors are (1^3),(1^20,5),(1^23). A primitive top cycle with coefficients ±1 is closed. The lifted column-difference cocycle has integral Bockstein, and an exact Alexander–Whitney sum evaluates to 2 modulo 5. All checks replay from verify.py.

value.rationale: The quotient is the canonical free fivefold column symmetry quotient of a classical ideal-tetrahedron/20-cusp chessboard model. Its mod-five Bockstein cup is a natural cohomology-operation invariant that distinguishes its homotopy type from a Moore-plus-spheres wedge with identical integral homology, rather than merely recomputing known Betti numbers.
